newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spaniards believe Gonzalez' decision is temporary.
newsitem.headline: Spaniards believe Gonzalez' decision is temporary.

text.p: Most Spaniards believe the decision by former Prime Minister Felipe Gonzalez to step down as Socialist party chief is only temporary, according to an opinion poll published on Tuesday by "El Pais" newspaper.
The poll carried out among 800 people shows that 70 percent believe the resignation is temporary and think it is likely Gonzalez will be back with a leading role in the country.
Only 19 percent of those questioned said they believe his decision to withdraw is permanent.

In reply to a question of whether Gonzalez would put himself forward at the next general election, 41 percent of those polled said they liked the idea, with 43 percent saying this was likely. Another 40 percent did not like the idea and 34 percent said it was unlikely.
In a scale between zero and 10 the popularity of Gonzalez is rated 6.5 by the poll, while the one of the new chief of the Socialist Party Joaquin Almunia is 5.6.
